# MedLens — AI-Powered Clinical Information Intelligence
> Transforming fragmented medical records into a structured, reference-range-verified clinical intelligence profile with complete data provenance and human clinician oversight.

## Overview
- **Product Name**: MedLens
- **Tagline**: AI-Powered Clinical Information Intelligence
- **Canonical Deployment**: https://medlens-ai-clinical-intelligence.vercel.app/
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/ShritanDammoju/medlens-ai-clinical-intelligence
- **Primary Clinical Purpose**: Aggregating scattered diagnostic reports, normalising diverse biomarker terminologies, validating parameters strictly against source-explicit reference intervals, identifying cross-record therapy conflicts, and enabling verified physician-in-the-loop review.

## Architectural Pipeline (10-Stage Deterministic Engine)
1. **Multimodal Ingestion**: Accepts PDF diagnostic sheets, scanned lab images, clinical summaries, and patient intake forms.
2. **Text Extraction & Tokenization**: OCR tokenization preserving tabular lab layouts and row groupings.
3. **Completeness Validation**: Validates whether extracted rows contain required numerical values, units, and laboratory identifiers.
4. **Terminology Normalization**: Maps diverse aliases (e.g. `Hb`, `HGB`, `Haemoglobin`) to standardized clinical terms (`Hemoglobin`) while recording verbatim source tokens.
5. **Source-Bound Reference Interval Extraction**: Extracts reference ranges explicitly stated on the originating laboratory document. If a range is omitted by the source laboratory, it is marked as `Cannot determine` rather than hallucinating population averages.
6. **Cross-Record Conflict Scanning**: Scans patient medications, allergies, and lab results across multiple historical reports to detect contradictory dosages, contraindications, or conflicting diagnosis timelines.
7. **Clinical Gap Detection**: Flags omitted baseline tests (e.g., missing kidney function panels alongside elevated blood glucose).
8. **Clarification Question Synthesis**: Generates targeted questions for the clinician to ask the patient during clinical consultation.
9. **End-to-End Lineage & Provenance**: Attaches explicit tags (`Patient Provided`, `Extracted from Report`, `AI Inferred`, `Verified`) to every data point.
10. **Human-in-the-Loop Review**: Clinician verification portal with granular override and audit logging for every adjusted value.

## Patient–Doctor Connection Architecture
- **Doctor Code System**: Clinicians receive a unique alphanumeric code (`MED-XXXXXX`).
- **Authorization Workflow**: Patients submit this code to transmit a connection request. Doctors approve or decline incoming requests from their dedicated Doctor Dashboard.
- **Sovereign Privacy**: Patients can immediately revoke clinician access at any time with one click.

## Regulatory & Standards Alignment
- **HIPAA Privacy & Security Rules** (45 CFR Part 160 and Part 164)
- **HL7 FHIR Release 4** (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) Observation & DiagnosticReport structures
- **FDA Action Plan on AI/ML-Enabled Medical Devices** (Transparency and human clinician accountability)
- **NIH NCBI Reference Range Methodology** (Demographic and instrument-specific variability)

## Clinical Disclaimer
MedLens provides assistive clinical information intelligence and information synthesis. It does NOT provide medical diagnosis or replace licensed physician consultation. All laboratory parameters and medication recommendations must be verified by a qualified healthcare professional.
